steps.en: Officer opens the furnished hirer/driver page from the menu
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman furnished hirer/driver dari menu

steps.en: Submissions waiting for review show by default, apart from notice search
steps.id: Submission yang menunggu review tampil default, terpisah dari pencarian notice

steps.en: Status column and filter tell pending apart from approved or rejected
steps.id: Kolom dan filter status membedakan pending dari approved atau rejected

steps.en: Submissions that fail the automatic checks are sent to officers as pending
steps.id: Submission yang gagal pengecekan otomatis dikirim ke officer sebagai pending

steps.en: Pending items appear on the officer's own dashboard
steps.id: Item pending muncul di dashboard milik officer
steps.why_en: The home dashboard is empty and nothing is assigned per officer; everyone shares one common list.
steps.why_id: Dashboard utama kosong dan tidak ada penugasan per officer; semua orang memakai satu daftar bersama.
